notes: NOV 2026 DISTINCT SOURCE-SCOPE GUARD. This publicly accessible addon is explicitly for WoW: Forever 1.60.1, NOT Retail Midnight 12.x. Its account-wide deObserved records group by class:quality:item level or special itemID and track n, per-result drops/qty, optional min/max, and first/last build. It does not publish any original player data or zero-inclusive event export; 100 disenchants is the author's UI reliability threshold, not a study. DO NOT use WoW Forever probabilities, item tables, event semantics, item levels or builds in Retail Midnight estimates. The public ArtisanLogbook issue #32 Retail positive-only examples were already indexed in prior Midnight evidence; not duplicated. No new 272246 actual-bonus successful disenchant, 237362 ranked prospecting, or 236761 10-herb mill original cohort found; all casts, hits, outputs and probability remain unknown for this lead.
lookingFor: Fresh source-original Retail Midnight 12.x, character/build/gear/skill-linked disenchant operation data via recently released ProfessionsForever and other public addon logs; filter out new 1.60.1 WoW Forever source contamination
